read.p: Each row is a line the Town Accountant’s system (MUNIS) printed for this fund: the date it posted, who was paid or what was deposited, the memo typed with it, and the amount.

Mostly monthly deposits from MyRec, the department’s registration system. The memo names the month the sales were made in, as PROG/SEP2024 PARK MYREC. Refunds and card charges post against them, so a month can net below its deposit. A few receipts name a league.
Invoices paid to instructors, contractors and suppliers, and journal entries that move a cost between this fund and the general fund. Only these and money in change the balance.
When an order is placed the system sets money aside (order opened) and releases it as the invoice is paid (order paid down). They show what was committed. They are not spending.
Each July a budget is posted to the fund, the amount it may spend that year. It is a limit, not money; the memo names who asked for it.

read.h: The account name is the clerk’s choice
read.p: Which fee account a deposit lands in (programme, beach, field) is typed with it. In May and June 2026 registration deposits were posted to beach fees, so the split between the three is not reliable. The total is.
